name: Cape Canaveral SLC-41
tagline: Atlas V's main pad — flew every Atlas V mission including Mars Perseverance + Lucy + Starliner CFT
description: United Launch Alliance's primary Atlas V pad at Cape Canaveral, originally built for Titan III in the 1960s, entirely demolished in 1999 and rebuilt as the Atlas V pad; first Atlas V flight 2002-08-21. Every Atlas V flight has launched from here — Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter, Curiosity, Perseverance, Lucy, Juno, the Boeing Starliner Crew Flight Test, and dozens of NSSL national-security missions. Also hosts Vulcan Centaur, which began flying from SLC-41 in January 2024.
